title: wezterminator machine settings
description: Per-layer machine settings (machine.json in the fleet and local layers; the built-in layer ships none). Personal values live only here: presets and themes have no field for them, so exporting a preset cannot leak them. No field has a personal default. Keys starting with an underscore are comments: '_' describes the enclosing object, '_<key>' describes the sibling '<key>'.

project_roots.description: Directories scanned by the project-workspace picker. Absolute or starting with ~/.

issue_url_pattern.description: URL template for quick-select issue keys. {key} is replaced by the matched key. When absent, the key is only copied.

issue_key_pattern.description: Regular expression that recognises an issue key in terminal text.

vpn_probes.description: Probes the stats collector runs. A probe that is absent or disabled is not run.

push_targets.description: Named push targets keyed by slug. Hosts are tried in order (for example a VPN name, then a LAN hostname).

dev_art_path.description: Development only. Directory holding hand-made art as <dev_art_path>/<theme slug>/<layer id>.png. Consulted before every other art source when set. Never exported, and doctor flags it.

screen_overrides.description: Device-pixel resolutions to use when WezTerm cannot report them or reports logical pixels. An entry with a name applies to the screen of that name; an entry without one applies to every screen.

command.description: Argument vector run without a shell, for kind 'command'.

profile.description: AWS VPN profile to watch, for kind 'aws_vpn'.
